scope: Real Auth, database, server GPS/time validation, realtime and browser with isolated temporary school. Device GPS positions simulated by browser permission API.
results: Real owner, teacher and staff authenticate
Owner UI saves teacher-only attendance, address and canonical coordinates with radius 100
Targeted teacher receives agenda without refresh
Browser GPS outside 100 m fails and writes no attendance
Real teacher check-in/check-out persists server timestamps and GPS
Creator and non-target staff cannot check in or read colleague attendance
Management detail shows actual attendance and receives live status
Mobile attendance and live page have no overflow or JavaScript errors
